tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyi spyan ltas 'ga' bzhugs so// mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi spyan ltas ni/ dpal sa skyar rje btsun rin po che'i sku 'dra mdze thod ma'i drung du sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams tshe ring thung yong gi spyan ltas 'byung bar/ dbo zla ba'i rje btsun rin po che'i dus chen tshes bcu gnyis kyi tho rangs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsol 'debs mdzad pa'i mnal lam du/ sngar gyi thugs sngar bzhugs pa'i grwa pa byams pa chos grags zer ba de byung nas/ nga la lo lnga bcu nga gcig la dog cha med zer byung bas/ rje nyid kyis slar lnga bcu nga lnga lta bu la med dam gsungs pas de la med/ drug cu la mas mtha' byas pa'i yong zer byung gsungs/ grwa pa de chos skyong gi sprul pa gcig yin par snang gsungs/ ༈ /yang rgyas bla ma mkhas btsun gyi rmi ltas la/ dgung lo so drug bdun gnyis sku dog tsam la/ brgyad cu gya gsum bzhugs/ sku rim stobs chen rang gis 'chun na gdung gcig tsam 'byung zer ba zhig tho rangs kyi rmi lam zhig tu byung lags/ ༈ yang lan gcig sku rim 'bur dod stobs gang che rang mdzad na gdung gnyis tsam yong zhu ba byung lags/ zhabs drung rin po che dgung lo gya gsum thog grags pa rang gi gnas su bde zhu ba byung lags pas/ rje btsun grags pa'i rnam 'phrul yin nges su 'dug pas bde ba can du 'byon zhu bar 'dug lags/ ༈ yang 'bro pa sngags 'chang rig 'dzin 'jigs bral gyi rmi ltas la/ cho 'phrul gyi tshes bcu gnyis kyi tho rangs/ cham rkyen zhig gis cung zad na ba'i gnyid srab po zhig gi rmi lam na/ ri sul chen po zhig gi sked la pha bong dkar po gcig la/ bu mo mdzes rab cig gi rjes la bu tsha gzhon nu kha lab shes mi shes shig khrid nas skor ba byed kyin 'dug pas/

khyed 'di la skor ba byed pa ci yin byas pas/ 'di slob dpon padma'i bzhugs khri yin zer/ bsam blo la mkha' 'gro ma 'dra e yin/ gong sa nas bka' phebs pa'i rmi lam sgugs gsungs pa/ rmi lam la tag tag rang med pas 'di la 'dri dgos bsam nas/ khyed la sa skya zhabs drung rin po che sku tshe snga ma gar 'khrungs/ phyi ma gar 'khrungs/ sku tshe ring thung shod rgyu e yod byas pas/ bu mo de nas nga la med/ 'di la yod yong zer ma thag bu tsha nas/ snga ma ni 'phags yul du rdzogs chen sems klong thams cad la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta zhig nas/ res grub thob/ res dge bshes/ res lo tsā ba sogs bod du yang 'khrungs pa zhig yin/ sku tshe ni gzhan rkyen gyis bar ma chad na ring la 'phrin las rgyas pa zhig yong / skabs skabs su dog cha phran bu 'dug ste/ khong res mkhyen pas gang 'os kyi bzlog pa gyis zer ba'i mod la gnyid sad/ ༈ /yang paṇa chen karma nā tha'i lung bstan la/ rta lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin paṇḍi ta karma nā thas nged rang gi lag ris bltas pa'i lung bstan byung ba la/ nged rang lo bdun cu don drug thub cing / de thog sku rim mang ja gsum/ bla brang rnams su dkar me gang mang dang / dar cog gsum btsugs na khal bzhi dang brgyad thub zer ba la/ lo lnga bcu nga bdun pa'i thog hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la/ dar cog dkar po gcig dkar me bcu gcig mang ja gcig rnams rim gro la dgos zer/ rang lo nyer bdun lon nas bzung / nyin re bzhin lugs gnyis thad nas dar rgyas je che je che la 'gro zer/ lo nyer dgu tshun la dge sdings kyang lag tu yong zer byung / rab 'byams pas lag ris bltas pas lung bstan byung pa la/ rang lo drug cu re dgu thub cing / de thog rim gro la brtson par byas na lo bdun cu don gsum thub zer byung / sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ /yang chos rje glang phu ba'i dam can gyi lung bstan la/

'di khar dam can spyan drangs pa'i lha ngag gtso bor zhabs drung rin po che'i sku tshe'i tshad/ sku dog che snyam pa'i skabs rnams su mang ja spong rta sogs thugs rtog zhib pa re gnang dgos/ gzhan ma sku tshe'i tshad bdun cu don gsum khag theg par byas song lags// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyi spyan ltas 'ga'/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
